baseline_findings: The report renderer already has a shared report model for Markdown and printable HTML, but the delivery path does not persist bytes.
Current export is reconstructible from mutable React state rather than an explicit historical ScenarioRevision plus Run source.
A report can show an optimization run identifier without making that Run the authoritative source for every section.
There is no immutable artifact identity, content hash, availability status, corruption handling, or later-download path.
The current report path does not silently rerun RF itself, but historical reconstruction was not available as an explicit product workflow.
